headline: Transfers of $50,000 for police vehicle repairs and $49,745 for parking garage security cameras, plus $935,860 in grant-funded spending.
summary: The agenda includes a $1,250,000 transfer from the General Fund Contingency account and a $689,545 General Fund addition. It also covers $40,000 in advisor fees for a request for proposals process and a $60,000 groundwater monitoring appropriation.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Joint Meeting of City Council and Board of Finance 
 
Join Zoom Meeting: 
https://bristolct-
gov.zoom.us/j/83756772336?pwd=LzOF7rbkwiT3ytO6avQMoKmeOssFDK.1 
Meeting ID: 837 5677 2336 Passcode: 123456 
Dial by your Location: +19292056099 (New York) 
 
**New Start time for this November meeting as voted on Special Meeting 
held on September 22, 2026** 
 
 
 
 
The regular Joint Meeting of City Council and Board of Finance will be held on Tuesday, 
November 10, 2026, at 6:30 PM. in City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, 
Connecticut. 
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 a. Approval of Minutes of the regular Joint Meeting held on October 13, 2026. 
3. Consent Agenda 
 a. To transfer $13,652 within the Insurance operating budget for auto insurance. 
 b. To make an additional appropriation of $13,375 within the Special Grants & 
Donations Fund and $46,000 within the Police Drug Forfeiture Fund. 
 c. To transfer $13,360 within the Code Enforcement budget for vehicles. 
 d. To make an additional appropriation of $60,000 within the Capital Projects Fund for 
groundwater monitoring. 
 e. To make an additional appropriation totaling $935,860 within the Special Grants & 
Donations Fund funded by grant revenue.
f. To make an additional appropriation totaling $112,580 within the Special Education 
Grant Fund funded by grant revenue. 
 g. To make an additional appropriation of $500 within the Fire Department's operating 
budget funded by contributions. 
 h. To make an additional appropriation of $60,000 within the Solid Waste Disposal Fund 
for solid waste barrels. 
 i. To approve the annual meeting calendar for joint meetings of the City Council and 
Board of Finance to December 2027. 
4. Police-Vehicle Service & Repair 
 a. To transfer $50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account to Police - Repairs 
& Maintenance. 
5. DPW Request-Parking Garage Security Cameras 
 a. To transfer $49,745 within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund. 
6. Advisor RFP Evaluation Fee and Estimate for RFI process 
 a. To transfer $40,000 from the General Fund Contingency account for Professional 
Fees.  
7. General Fund 
 a. To make an additional appropriation of $689,545 within the General Fund as of June 
30, 2026. 
8. General Fund Contingency Account 
 a. To transfer $1,250,000 from the General Fund Contingency account as of June 30, 
2026. 
9. Road Improvements Fund 
 a. To make an additional appropriation of $101,021 and transfers totaling $7,995 within 
the Road Improvements Fund as of June 30, 2026. 
10. Monthly Reports 
 a. Monthly revenue and expense report presentation by Comptroller. 
11. Any other matter to come before said meeting
12. Adjournment 
  
Erica Cabiya  
Town & City Clerk
